how_it_works.heading: How it works
steps: Boil water and let it rest for 30 seconds.
Pour a little water over the grounds and wait 30 seconds.
Pour slowly in circles until the carafe reaches the line.
Lift the dripper and serve. Rinse the filter and you're done.
